title: UK Summer Institutes
field: Summer study programmes at UK universities
about: The US-UK Fulbright Commission invites US undergraduate students with little or no experience outside North America to apply for its 2027 UK Summer Institutes. Applications opened on 12 November 2026.
requirements: US citizen with a US passport
At least two years of undergraduate study remaining after the Institute
card_alt: EduCut Connect card for UK Summer Institutes at US-UK Fulbright Commission, United Kingdom, deadline 2 Feb 2027. The background photo shows Big Ben, the Palace of Westminster and the green arches of Westminster Bridge in London under a blue sky.
